paragraphs.text: Dinitra La Croix was a sorceress who fought in the Great Magus War on Antausia .

During the Great Magus War on Antausia, Dinitra learned of the pure magical energy pools of Beldingard. She conquered the realm so she would have direct access to its mana pools and held the area for nearly 80 years.
Ignatius Firestorm and his apprentice Valdusian Tomer challenged her with an army, and she watched in horror as Ignatius's army harnessed the same energies she had from her pools.
